# Vendor Sources

This directory is reserved for unmodified upstream sources.

| Source | URL | Status |
|---|---|---|
| DJI RoboMaster C Board examples | https://github.com/RoboMaster/Development-Board-C-Examples | Pending: network unavailable in provisioning environment |
| FashionStar SDK | https://github.com/servodevelop/servo-uart-rs485-sdk | Pending: network unavailable in provisioning environment |

The build must not substitute locally rewritten HAL, CMSIS, FreeRTOS, BMI088, INS, USB, or actuator drivers for these sources. Once network access is available, clone each repository here and record the exact commit plus the selected project paths before enabling the firmware target.
